summary: Verified P0 Video Export Fix - POST /api/course/{project_id}/export-video now returns jobId INSTANTLY (< 1 second) without doing any heavy work. All 8 backend tests passed. Frontend video export UI working correctly with progress bar and polling.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: POST /export-video returns jobId in < 300ms (was timing out before fix)
GOOD: All heavy work (FFmpeg, project fetch, validation) moved to background async task via asyncio.create_task()
GOOD: Job persistence uses fire-and-forget pattern with asyncio.ensure_future(create_job())
GOOD: Frontend useEditorExport.js has retry with exponential backoff on initial POST (3 retries)
GOOD: Frontend tolerates intermittent 502/504 during polling (up to 10 consecutive errors)
GOOD: Frontend has 10-minute max polling timeout
GOOD: Job status transitions correctly: processing -> completed (with downloadUrl) or processing -> failed
GOOD: Non-existent project returns jobId instantly, job fails with proper message in background
GOOD: Backend remains responsive to other requests while video is processing (non-blocking)

bug_fix_verification.root_cause: POST /export-video was doing heavy work (FFmpeg check, project fetch, validation) synchronously before returning, causing Cloudflare/Nginx proxy timeouts (502/504)
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: All heavy work moved to background async task via asyncio.create_task(). Job ID created and returned immediately with fire-and-forget MongoDB persistence.
bug_fix_verification.verification_method: Measured response time < 300ms, verified job status polling works, confirmed video export completes successfully
